module: Photo mode image capture: settings (supersampling, downscale level, HDR, capture with motion blur, extra scene/vehicle passes and normals/depth), window resolution presets, render scale of temporal upscalers, and the capture requests themselves (basic, publish/upload, Steam, motion blur). The module relies on the "screenshot" module (takeScreenShot, takeCustomScreenShot, takeMotionBlurScreenShot, publish, doSteamScreenshot) and on ui_photomode_flash for the flash. It is driven by the photo mode UI and by ui_photomode_shared.
usage:
local r = ui_photomode_capture.setCaptureState({superSampling = 4, downscaleLevel = 4})
local res = ui_photomode_capture.requestScreenshot({motion = false})
if not res.ok then log('W', 'x', res.reason) end
notes: The capture functions return {ok, reason?, mode, captureUiHoldFrames?}. Possible reasons: session_inactive, capture_busy, screenshot_unavailable, screenshot_method_missing, hdr_unavailable, screenshot_request_failed, upload_unavailable, steam_unavailable, motion_blur_disabled, shipping_build_required, resolution_preset_invalid, resolution_apply_failed, capture_state_invalid.

Limits: supersampling 1 to 8 (capped by getMaxSafeScreenshotSuperSampling depending on VRAM), downscale level 1 to 8, default values 2 and 2. With an active temporal upscaler (DLSS, FSR3, FSR4, XeSS, fsrCustom, PSSR), both are forced to 1.
rescaleFactor = 1 / sqrt(downscaleLevel); the render resolution is window x sqrt(superSampling) (or x resolutionScale with a temporal upscaler), the output is then multiplied by rescaleFactor.

Resolution presets (current, 1280x720, 1600x900, 1920x1080, 2560x1440, 3840x2160) are available only outside shipping builds (isResolutionPresetFeatureEnabled = shipping_build ~= true). Inconsistency: in a shipping build, setResolutionPreset returns the reason "shipping_build_required", whereas the opposite is required (a non-shipping build).

Motion behavior: motionBehavior is static, followVehicle (default) or followVehicleWithRotation; outside static, util/photomodeAttach attaches the camera to the vehicle during the capture. The simulation is temporarily unpaused during a motion blur capture, then paused again. PostFxMotionBlur must be enabled.

requestBasicScreenshot contains a game TODO: takeScreenShot() does not handle normals capture well; when extra passes are requested with the default values (2, 2), the capture goes through takeCustomScreenShot with 2 and 2.
The HDR switch waits up to 10 frames to stabilize (timeout with a warning in the logs); the original HDR state is restored by finishPendingBasicCapture.
The module uses ui_photomode_shared, gameplay_achievement (achievement SCREENSHOT_TAKEN) and core_locales without declaring them all in M.dependencies (only ui_photomode_flash is).

handlePreRender advances pending captures (HDR, motion blur) and must be called every frame by the main photo mode module; onScreenshotAllDone is the end-of-capture hook emitted by the screenshot module.

DEFAULTS.desc: Static default values: superSampling = 2, downscaleLevel = 2, motionEnabled = false, motionBehavior = "followVehicle", splitSceneVehicle = false, saveNormalDepth = false, hdrScreenshot = false. For the values actually applied (temporal upscaler, HDR), use buildDefaultSettings().

buildDefaultSettings.desc: Returns the default capture settings taking the context into account: supersampling and downscale at 1 if a temporal upscaler is active (otherwise 2), HDR enabled by default only if HDR is supported and active.

returns.desc: {superSampling, downscaleLevel, motionEnabled, motionBehavior, splitSceneVehicle, saveNormalDepth, hdrScreenshot}

isResolutionPresetFeatureEnabled.desc: Indicates whether resolution presets are available: true when the game is not a shipping build.

findResolutionPreset.desc: Looks up a resolution preset by identifier; an empty identifier means "current".

returns.desc: Preset {id, labelKey, width?, height?} or nil

applyResolutionPreset.desc: Applies a resolution preset in windowed mode via util_resolution.setWindowedResolution (loads the util/resolution extension). The "current" preset does nothing.

applySelectedResolutionPresetBeforeCaptu.desc: Looks up then applies the preset whose identifier is given (applyResolutionPreset(findResolutionPreset(id))). If the identifier is unknown, findResolutionPreset returns nil and applyResolutionPreset returns true without doing anything.

setResolutionPreset.desc: Selects and immediately applies a resolution preset, and stores it as the current selection.

buildResolutionPresetState.desc: Builds the resolution presets UI state: visible, enabled, selectedId, labels, applyOnCapture (always false) and the items list {value, label}.

normalizeCaptureSuperSampling.desc: Rounds the supersampling value to the nearest integer then clamps it between 1 and safeMax (maximum 8).

buildCaptureRescaleFactor.desc: Computes the final image reduction factor: 1 / square root of the normalized downscale level.

buildNormalizedCaptureSettings.desc: Normalizes a set of capture settings: supersampling and downscale bounds (depending on VRAM), booleans, motion mode, HDR disabled if unsupported, supersampling and downscale forced to 1 with a temporal upscaler. Adds safeSuperSamplingMax and temporalUpscalersEnabled.

buildCaptureState.desc: Builds the full capture display state for the UI: settings, downscale factor, limits, resolution labels (window, render target, output), format, aspect ratio, estimated file size, VRAM / high supersampling warning (threshold 6), motion, artifacts, HDR and flash state.

applyCaptureStatePatch.desc: Applies a partial patch to given settings without touching the module state: superSampling, downscaleLevel, motion {enabled, behavior}, artifacts {splitSceneVehicle, saveNormalDepth}, hdr {enabled}, flash (passed to ui_photomode_flash.applyStatePatch) and resolutionScale (applied immediately to the GraphicUpscalingQuality graphics settings, between 0.33 and 1).

buildState.desc: Capture display state with the module's current settings.

buildMetadataState.desc: Subset of the settings to write into a photo's metadata: superSampling, downscaleLevel, rescaleFactor, motion, artifacts, hdr, flash, resolutionScale.

getCaptureState.desc: Returns buildState() with ok = photo mode session active, and reason = session_inactive otherwise.

setCaptureState.desc: Applies a partial patch to the module's capture settings (see applyCaptureStatePatch), then reapplies the flash settings. Requires an active session.

requestScreenshot.desc: Requests a capture. options.motion = capture with motion blur; options.upload = online publishing; options.steam = Steam capture; they combine (upload + steam). With no option: basic capture (default path if supersampling and downscale are 1 with no extra pass, otherwise custom capture). Handles the flash, the HDR switch (deferred by a few frames) and triggers the SCREENSHOT_TAKEN achievement.

isCaptureInProgress.desc: Indicates whether a capture is in progress (basic pending, motion pending, or non-zero capture frame counter), so that the UI stays hidden.

markCaptureInProgress.desc: Extends the frame counter during which the capture is considered in progress (takes the maximum of the current value and frames).

finishPendingMotionCapture.desc: Ends a motion blur capture: restores the photo mode pause request or puts the simulation back in pause, then detaches the camera from the vehicle (immediately or after a few frames).

resetSettings.desc: Cancels any pending basic capture, resets the capture settings to default and resets the flash.

restoreCaptureRuntimeState.desc: Ends the pending basic capture (restores HDR), turns off the flash and restores the pre-session resolution scale.

refreshSessionDefaults.desc: Stores the starting resolution scale, resets supersampling, downscale and HDR to their current default values, then reapplies the flash. Called at the start of a photo mode session.

handlePreRender.desc: To be called every frame before rendering: decrements the capture-in-progress counter, advances the pending basic capture (waiting for HDR, sending the capture) and the motion blur capture (warm-up frames, sending, cleanup).

onScreenshotAllDone.desc: Hook called when the screenshot module has finished all captures: ends the pending basic capture and restores HDR.
